title: Battle of Raphia: Ptolemy IV defeats Antiochus III (217 BC)
summary: Antiochus III invaded Ptolemaic Coele-Syria and was defeated by Ptolemy IV near Raphia on the Egyptian border; Ptolemy recovered Coele-Syria and granted a truce.
external_reason: Proposed by most interpreters as the event of Dan 11:11–12.

mentions.notes: Proposed correlation only (Jerome; Driver; Guzik); Daniel names no king or place.

scripture_extraction.reason: External historical event, researched because interpreters read Daniel 11 as foretelling it; no biblical narrative of it in the 66-book index.
